ns2:course.label: Contemporary Children's Literature
ns2:course.description: Critically examines literature written for children and youth, including books that have received major national and international awards and prizes; gives particular attention to contemporary children's literature publications and their implications for use in the elementary classroom and school curriculum. 4 graduate hours. No professional credit. Credit is not given for CI 568 if credit for CI 467 has been given. Prerequisite: Admission to the elementary education licensure graduate program. This course is intended as a graduate course for master's degree students in the elementary education licensure program only. It is not intended to be taken as part of a non-licensure Ed.M. or other graduate degree program.
